Page.title: 豌豆
Page.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): -8°C - 20°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 25 - 80 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 蔬菜类$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): +70 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): 30 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): 30$()$(br2)豌豆是攀爬作物。豆科攀爬作物，根瘤固氮，卷须攀架而上。$(br2)种子播在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上，上方留空，用木棍右键下半株搭架才能继续长高。完全成熟后破坏任意半株收获并返种、返棍，各结算一次；空手右键不采摘。$(br2)

Page.title: Pea
Page.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): -8°C - 20°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)Hydration$(): 25 - 80 %$(br)$(bold)Category$(): Vegetable$(br2)$(bold)$(3)Nitrogen$(): +70 $(bold)$(6)Phosphorous$(): 30 $(bold)$(d)Potassium$(): 30$()$(br2)Pea is a climbing crop: a climbing legume that fixes nitrogen and twines up a trellis.$(br2)Sow on $(l:tfc:food/farmland)farmland$() with space above. To grow tall, right-click the lower plant with a wooden stick. Once fully grown, break either half to harvest and return seeds and the stick once. Empty-hand right-click does not harvest.$(br2)
